description.value: Sawasdee Thai has been a Vancouver institution since 1986, recognized as one of the city's first Thai restaurants and a long-standing fixture on Main Street. The family-owned restaurant serves authentic Thai cuisine—from pad thai and tom yum to Thai barbecue and regional specialties—prepared with fresh ingredients rooted in time-honored recipes. It is deeply embedded in the local community, participating in events like Main Street Car Free Day and the Vancouver Thai Festival.
